payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image visibly use a chalk-like drawing medium, rather than merely having grain, blur, or smudging?
node.criteria: pass: affirmative visible chalk-like marks or material treatment establish a chalk medium; fail: visible evidence establishes a different medium or treatment without chalk; unknown: grain, smudging, or other cues are suggestive but do not resolve the medium.
node.binding: Assess only visible evidence of chalk-like medium or treatment; do not infer chalk from generic texture or from drawing style.
